Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
You can add items (like treats or probiotics) to an upcoming order, but only before your order deadline. Once that deadline passes, the order is placed and charged and changes (including adding items) can’t be made for that box. Any additions after that will apply to a future delivery instead.
Adding Extras to Your Order

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
says:
Once an order is already on its way, it’s essentially locked in. Our info explains that you need to reschedule, change meals, or cancel before your order deadline; after that, the order is placed and your payment method is charged. So if it’s already shipped, changes would apply only to future deliveries, not that box.
